name: development-claude-plugin
description: Plugin family for projects that ARE Claude Code plugins. Ships a test harness (/development-claude-plugin:test), a review panel (/development-claude-plugin:review — 5 read-only agents: prose logic, contract integrity, script quality, tests, manifests), and a maintenance dispatcher (a topic plugin: composes alongside the language plugin via /development:maintenance). Validators: version sync (claude-plugin-version-sync), SKILL.md/agent frontmatter (claude-plugin-skill-validator), orphaned skill/agent references (claude-plugin-reference-checker), directory layout (claude-plugin-structure-validator), and shell-script quality (claude-plugin-script-quality: shellcheck / zsh -n / shebang consistency). Its five read-only reviewers (contract-integrity, prose-logic, script-reviewer, test-reviewer, manifest-check) now carry a byte-identical evidence rule (#1584): a finding whose claim IS a tool run's verdict — a linter would flag this, a suite run would come back red, a validator would reject this, a version-sync script would report a mismatch — is capped at SUGGESTION unless the reviewer ran the tool and quotes it, and instead names `decides: <read-only command>` plus the `proposed-severity:` the conductor may promote it to on a real red, with a slot for both lines in each Reporting Format. The line it draws is observation vs. execution, not subject matter, so a defect read straight out of the artifacts — two manifests disagreeing about a version, a changed script with no test file beside it — keeps full severity under the agent's own bar.
